steps.what: Prepare a training handout from the approved specification.

loop.output: A handout that quotes only that version
loop.check: Each step in the handout cites a specification section
loop.stop: One draft; an uncited step is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The lesson prose changes even when the specification figures do not

steps.what: Train system designers and users in the room.
Answer a follow-up support question from a system designer.
File the training handout on the document store.

tasks.design: The handout is drafted from the issued specification on {DOCS}, and the computer hardware engineer checks that it cites that version. Training system designers and users stays in the room. The handout is not a score of any person, and a follow-up that the specification does not answer is answered by the engineer or left open.
tasks.previous_blocker: Handouts were copied from an old specification and corrected in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: A cited handout can be refreshed when the specification version changes. The session cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A question in the room that shows the specification is wrong.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees who is lost even when the handout is correct.
tasks.altitude: Preparing the handout is shorter. The session stays. The engineer does not gain a right to score learners.

reach.role: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
reach.task: Follow a handout while supporting a running system
reach.learn: Which steps they cannot do from the handout alone

evidence.claim: A specification can be filled from records, with prose drafted around those figures. Every number has to trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
A time study that checks presence, behaviour or performance needs works council consent. This task does not score individual people.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from an issued specification to a session and a filed handout. Assessing a learner is out of scope.
Fields are specification version, section cited and handout date. The specification produces the figures. Fallback: the engineer writes the handout with no draft.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1.5 hours per 100 baseline hours is the handout outline.
unknowns: Who attends, and whether attendance is recorded.
Whether the works council treats an attendance list as a performance record.
research_questions: How often does the specification change between sessions?
Which questions in the room are absent from the handout?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: each session is a new audience and the room is the work. High case: the handout is ready and only the session and the follow-up remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Monitor functioning of the equipment on the status board.
Read an alarm that is outside the specification.
Modify the equipment so the system conforms.
Record the modification and the conformance check.

tasks.design: A status board on {BI} lists equipment that is outside a specification limit the computer hardware engineer already set. Reading that alarm is a check. Modifying the equipment so the system conforms stays on the hardware. The record on {DOCS} states what changed, and an alarm inside the limit is not a modification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status was noticed late, and the change was written up afterwards if at all.
tasks.enabler_now: A limit alarm can refresh. The modification on the equipment cannot.
tasks.still_hard: An alarm caused by a sensor, not by the equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can tell a real drift from a bad reading.

ambition.what: The engineer decides whether an alarm needs a modification or is a bad reading.

tasks.altitude: Watching a quiet board takes less time. The modification, when it is needed, stays.

reach.task: Notice when a line stop is caused by this equipment
reach.learn: Which alarms they see before the engineer does

evidence.claim: A pass or fail against a numeric limit can be computed from the recorded value. A fail the limit does not explain stays with the engineer.
Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from equipment status to a modification recorded against the specification. Designing a new product is out of scope.

Fields are equipment id, measurement, limit, alarm time and modification text. The status feed produces the measurement. The engineer writes the limit. Fallback: the engineer reads the instrument and types the row.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours is the limit list on the board.
unknowns: Whether the status feed already exists.
Who is allowed to change a limit on the board.
research_questions: What share of alarms are bad readings?
How often is a modification done with no record?

incremental.description: Maintain alarm limits on the status board

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the equipment often needs a hands-on change. High case: the board is quiet and only real alarms take time. The modification itself stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Set the expected load and margin for the power supply.
Calculate rails from the load and the design specifications.
Draft the power supply requirements and configuration.

loop.output: Requirement sentences that quote only that table
loop.check: Each watt, voltage and margin matches the table or the sentence is cut
loop.stop: One draft, then the engineer edits
loop.why_not_simpler: The numbers are fixed and the requirement text is prose

steps.what: Check the note against system performance expectations.
Issue the power supply specification for the build.

tasks.design: The computer hardware engineer sets the expected load and the margin. Rails are then load times the rules in the design specification, on a {SPREADSHEET}, with no new model. A draft may quote only that table. The engineer checks it against performance expectations and issues the power supply specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Loads, rails and the written requirement were three inconsistent sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: The rail arithmetic can be repeated once the load is set. Setting the load and signing the specification cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A load that is honest on paper and too low in the product.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which peak the average load hides.

ambition.what: The engineer decides the load and margin that the rest of the specification must use.

tasks.altitude: Retyping rails shrinks. The engineer still sets the load and still issues the specification.

reach.task: Check that a power rail can feed their circuit
reach.learn: Which margin they treat as too thin

evidence.claim: A specification can be filled from records, with prose drafted around those figures. Every number has to trace to a record, and the engineer signs.
The Machinery Regulation covers AI safety functions from 20 January 2027. It applies when the hardware is a safety function of machinery.
The engineer who signs stays responsible for the design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from performance expectations and a load the engineer sets, to an issued power supply specification. Board design beyond the supply is out of scope.
Fields are rail name, voltage, current, margin percent and unit. The engineer sets the load and margin. The sheet produces the rail figures. Fallback: a rail that cannot be calculated is left blank.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 3 hours per 100 baseline hours is the rail rules.
unknowns: Whether this supply is a safety function of machinery.
Who else must sign before the build uses the specification.
research_questions: How often is the expected load revised after the first prototype?
How often do issued rails disagree with the sheet?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the load is uncertain and the check dominates. High case: the load is stable and the rails and the draft are repeatable. Issuing still waits for the check.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assemble existing equipment for a special need.

steps.what: List existing pieces of equipment for this need.
Assemble existing pieces of equipment on the bench.
Modify the assembly to meet the special need.

tasks.design: A pick list names existing pieces, location and the special need. Assembling and modifying that equipment stays on the bench with the computer hardware engineer. The list does not choose the modification, and a piece that is not on the list is fetched by the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: The hunt for an existing piece took as long as the assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: A pick list can be kept. The assembly and the modification cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A special need that no existing piece can meet.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer can see, with the pieces in hand, that the list was wrong.
tasks.altitude: Finding a known piece is shorter. The bench work is unchanged.

reach.task: Say whether an assembled special can be repeated on the line
reach.learn: Which one-off assemblies they will not put into a standard route

evidence.claim: Design, bench work, assembly, supervision and teaching stay with the engineer. A draft is not a signed design.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer hardware engineer.
Boundary: from a special need to a modified assembly of existing equipment. Buying a new piece is out of scope.
Fields are piece id, location and the need it is meant to meet. The engineer writes them. Fallback: the list is a handwritten note on the bench.
Test native configuration of the named slot before custom code. If the slot cannot hold the fields, the engineer keeps today's document and the change waits.
Time a system already spends running, with nobody watching, is not the engineer's time and is not a saving.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours is the piece list.
unknowns: Whether existing equipment is already labelled and listed.
How often the special need really requires a new part.
research_questions: How long is the search compared with the assembly?
How often is the modified assembly used only once?

incremental.description: Maintain the list of existing pieces

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low case: the need is odd and the bench is almost all of the task. High case: the pieces are listed and only the assembly and the modification remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Teaching, assembly and hands-on modification stay. Rail arithmetic and alarm watching take less of the week. The engineer still sets the load and still changes the equipment.
reach: Electrical Engineers, on which power margin is too thin.
Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians, on which handout steps fail in the room.
skills_to_grow: Setting a load that matches the real peak.
Teaching from the specification version people will actually use.
role.ambitious_version: A power specification is issued only after the engineer has accepted the load, and a modification is recorded against the limit that triggered it.
